menu.dropin_coop.title: Co-op Worlds
text.dropin_coop.empty: No co-op worlds yet. Import one of your worlds, or join with an invite.
text.dropin_coop.drop_hint: You can also drop a world folder or .zip here.
text.dropin_coop.list_failed: The co-op world list could not be read. See the log.
text.dropin_coop.first_join_needs_host: Nobody is playing this world right now. Your first join needs a friend to be online, because there is no copy on this PC yet.
text.dropin_coop.sync.waiting_direct: Waiting for a direct connection to sync world data.
text.dropin_coop.sync.diverged: Your copy and the host's copy have split
text.dropin_coop.sync.incomplete_nobody: Nobody is online and your copy is %s%% downloaded. Play again when a friend is online to finish the download.
text.dropin_coop.status.no_copy: Nobody online, and no copy on this PC yet
text.dropin_coop.status.unreachable: Can't check who is online; you can still host
text.dropin_coop.import.title: Import a world as co-op
text.dropin_coop.import.none: No worlds in saves that are not co-op yet.
text.dropin_coop.import.copy_attached: This copy of %s is ready to play.
text.dropin_coop.import.open: %s is open right now. Close it first.
text.dropin_coop.import.needs_invite: %s is a co-op world, but this PC has no key for it. Use Join with invite.
text.dropin_coop.import.too_old: %s is from an older version. Open it once in singleplayer to upgrade it, then import.
text.dropin_coop.import.too_new: %s is from a newer version of the game and cannot be imported.
text.dropin_coop.import.no_level_dat: %s is not a world: there is no level.dat in it.
text.dropin_coop.import.not_a_world: %s is not a world folder or a .zip of one.
text.dropin_coop.import.zip_escape: %s was refused: it contains a file path that leaves the world folder.
text.dropin_coop.import.backup_failed: The backup of %s failed, so nothing was changed.
text.dropin_coop.import.copy_failed: %s could not be copied into saves.
text.dropin_coop.invite.title: Invite to %s
text.dropin_coop.invite.explain: Send this code to your friends. Anyone who has it can join this world.
text.dropin_coop.invite.bad: That is not a valid invite code.
text.dropin_coop.invite.failed: The invite could not be saved. See the log.
text.dropin_coop.join.title: Join with invite
text.dropin_coop.join.label: Paste the invite code
text.dropin_coop.remove.title: Remove %s from co-op?
text.dropin_coop.remove.question: The world stays as an ordinary singleplayer world. The co-op key on this PC is deleted; you need the invite to join again.
text.dropin_coop.remove.done: %s is no longer a co-op world on this PC.
text.dropin_coop.remove.failed: %s could not be removed. See the log.
text.dropin_coop.owner.not_owner: Only the owner of %s has an owner key.
text.dropin_coop.owner.exported: Owner key saved to %s. Keep it private and safe.
text.dropin_coop.owner.export_failed: The owner key of %s could not be exported. See the log.
text.dropin_coop.players.title: Players
text.dropin_coop.mods.title: Mods of this world
text.dropin_coop.mods.none: This world uses no mods besides DropIn Co-op.
text.dropin_coop.mods.unknown: The mod list of this world is not known yet. Join it once to see it.
text.dropin_coop.mods.consent.title: Mods for %s
text.dropin_coop.mods.consent.changed: The owner changed this world's mods while you were in it.
text.dropin_coop.mods.consent.summary: This world needs %s mods. %s to download (%s), %s to remove.
text.dropin_coop.mods.consent.trust: Mods are programs that run on your PC. These were chosen by %s, the owner of this world. Only go on if you trust them.
text.dropin_coop.mods.consent.restart: After the download the game closes. Start it again to play.
text.dropin_coop.mods.consent.moved: Your own mods are not deleted. They are moved to mods/.dropin-disabled.
text.dropin_coop.mods.consent.closing: Done. The game closes now. Start it again to play.
text.dropin_coop.mods.error.nobody: Nobody is hosting this world right now, and these mods are not on Modrinth. Try again when a friend is playing.
text.dropin_coop.mods.error.path: %s can only come from the host, and the connection to the host is relayed. Mods are not sent over a relay.
text.dropin_coop.mods.error.hash: %s did not match the owner's mod list and was thrown away.
text.dropin_coop.mods.error.failed: The mods could not be installed: %s
text.dropin_coop.policy.update.title: Update this world's mod list?
text.dropin_coop.policy.update.game: The game version or mod loader changed.
text.dropin_coop.policy.update.friends: Your friends will be asked to download the change and restart before they can play again.
text.dropin_coop.policy.update.warning: Removing a mod can remove its blocks and items from the world.
text.dropin_coop.policy.rejected: The host sent rules for this world that were not signed by its owner (%s). Not joining.
text.dropin_coop.policy.version: This world is played on Minecraft %s. This game is %s.
text.dropin_coop.policy.loader: This world is played with the %s mod loader. This game uses %s.
text.dropin_coop.policy.kept_extras: You keep mods that are not part of this world (%s). You can join it, but not host it.
text.dropin_coop.policy.mods_mismatch: Your mods do not match this world's mod list, so you cannot host it yet.
text.dropin_coop.policy.datapacks_mismat: The datapacks of your copy do not match the owner's. Join once while someone else is hosting to get them.
text.dropin_coop.policy.banned: The owner of this world has banned you from it.
text.dropin_coop.policy.failed: The rules of this world could not be checked: %s
text.dropin_coop.handoff.preparing: Handing the world over to your friends…
text.dropin_coop.handoff.nobody: Nobody else has a full copy yet (%s %s%%). Quit anyway?
text.dropin_coop.handoff.taking_over: Host is changing… you are the new host
text.dropin_coop.join.nobody: Nobody is online. Join adds the world to your list.
text.dropin_coop.join.unreachable: Can't check who is online. Join adds the world to your list.
text.dropin_coop.settings.title: World settings: %s
text.dropin_coop.savepoint.title: Save points of %s
text.dropin_coop.savepoint.name: Name (letters, digits, _ and -)
text.dropin_coop.savepoint.exported: Exported to %s in the backups folder
text.dropin_coop.savepoint.world_open: Close the world first, or use /dropin savepoint while hosting
text.dropin_coop.savepoint.owner_only: Only the world owner can use save points, while hosting
text.dropin_coop.savepoint.confirm_resto: Roll the world back to %s? The world as it is now is kept as before-restore.
